key_insight: LMV-Net combines longitudinal alignment with both CC and MLO mammography views to improve breast cancer risk prediction.
clinical_relevance: This approach could support more personalized screening intervals and earlier identification of patients at higher risk.
method: Jointly analyzes complementary CC and MLO views.
Uses an explicitly aligned longitudinal framework across screening mammograms.
Benchmarked against state-of-the-art risk prediction methods.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on the public EMBED and CSAW-CC datasets, where it consistently outperformed existing methods overall and across breast density and cancer subgroups.
watch_item: Performance gains on retrospective datasets still need prospective validation and careful integration into real-world screening workflows.
paper_title: Longitudinal Multi-View Breast Cancer Risk Prediction
